name: Crossroads Conscription
summary: Kargal Battlescar sends recruits west from the Far Watch Post to report at Crossroads Conscription. With his signed letter, you make for Sergra Darkthorn at the Barrens’ central hub.

sections.title: Reporting for Duty
sections.body: After you prove your worth, Kargal Battlescar sends you west from the Far Watch Post. He gives you a signed letter of recruitment for the journey along the packed dirt road through the Barrens’ arid brush. The road reaches a central junction where the Crossroads links northern Kalimdor with the southern wilderness.

sections.title: The Shaman of the Crossroads
sections.body:
At the Crossroads, Sergra Darkthorn receives new arrivals. Warchief Thrall chose the sharp-tongued orc shaman to oversee its operations. Kargal Battlescar grumbles that she is difficult and talks too much, though Thrall holds her in high esteem.

Sergra is fierce and unyielding. She reminds recruits, especially arrogant men, that female warriors and leaders stand as equals in Thrall’s Horde. Insolence has no place here.

faq.q: Who sends me on this quest?
faq.answer: Kargal Battlescar, an orc veteran at the Far Watch Post just west of the bridge between Durotar and the Barrens, sends you west with a letter for Sergra.
Sergra Darkthorn is near the road crossing at the center of the Crossroads, where caravans and messengers meet.

faq.q: Why does Kargal complain about Sergra?
faq.answer: Kargal finds Sergra aggravating. He calls her a nasty shaman who talks in circles before anyone can get to practical work, though he respects Thrall’s command to send recruits to her.

faq.q: Why does Sergra speak differently to male and female characters?
faq.answer: Sergra takes pride in Thrall’s mandate of equality for female warriors in the Horde. She encourages female recruits and warns male recruits that she will not tolerate disrespect or insolence.

faq.q: What route should I take to reach the Crossroads?
faq.answer: Follow the main road west from the Far Watch Post to a T-intersection. Turn left and follow the southern road into the Crossroads.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Sergra Darkthorn?
faq.answer: Sergra accepts your help at the Crossroads and sends you to aid with local threats, hunting, and outpost security throughout the central Barrens.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you leave the safety of your homeland to serve in the contested wilderness of the Barrens.
As an orc, you can see Thrall’s Horde changing, as merit and spiritual insight challenge the old clan ways of traditional grunt work.
As a shaman, you see Sergra Darkthorn lead as a spiritual adviser, military commander, and administrator at a strategic outpost.
